Chapter 292: Chapter 4 The Second Physical Body Divine Ability (Please Subscribe)

“I must be overthinking it,”

“Even if my obedient disciple has just begun to grasp space rules and stepped into the Seventh Rank with ease,”

“But breaking from the Seventh Rank to the Eighth Rank… it’s not so simple…”

The Chikun Star Lord comforted himself.

Given his countless opportunities, and even after he had seized a Starry Sky Wanderer Kun juvenile, entering the Eighth Layer was still extremely difficult.

Even if Lin Yuan’s talent exceeded his back then, facing the barrier of the Eighth Layer, he couldn’t just step over it, right?

...

“Ah…”

“Sometimes, having a disciple that’s too monstrously talented makes being a master somewhat meaningless…”

The Chikun Star Lord sighed.

…

Inside the palace of the Thirteen Peaks.

“The Red Spirit Fluid has arrived…”

Lin Yuan looked at a small kettle in front of him.

The small kettle was a space storage treasure. It appeared to be the size of a palm, but in reality, it contained a small pool’s worth of Red Spirit Fluid.

“Let’s begin.”

Lin Yuan pulled the stopper out of the small kettle.

Though he had not yet decided on the content of the Sixth Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, he had already finalized his plan for the Sixth Rank.

With the Red Spirit Fluid in the kettle, Lin Yuan would be able to reach the limit of the Sixth Rank in a short amount of time.

“I wonder what kind of Physical Body Divine Ability will be born this time…”

An expectant look crossed Lin Yuan’s face.

In the Immortal Tao World, the divine abilities of the fleshly body from the Body Cultivation lineage depended on the peculiar powers contained deep within one’s bloodline.

When Lin Yuan established the Sixth Rank chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, he had borrowed from the Body Cultivation lineage, particularly in terms of digging deeper into the physical body.

So—

Theoretically, the Sixth Rank chapter should also be able to give birth to Physical Body Divine Abilities.

As Lin Yuan retraced the steps of the Sixth Rank, the differences in his fleshly body would lead to the final Physical Body Divine Ability being different.

Gurgle…

Lin Yuan picked up the small kettle and swallowed all the Red Spirit Fluid.

As soon as the fluid slid down his throat, it turned into pure energy that nourished his limbs and extremities.

Several days later.

Lin Yuan abruptly opened his eyes.

“I’ve reached the pinnacle of the Sixth Rank…”

Lin Yuan dared not break through any further.

Now, if he wished, he could quickly step into the Seventh Rank.

But he wasn’t very satisfied with that kind of Seventh Rank; it didn’t complement the first five stages of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path very well.

“The Seventh Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path should have enough comprehension of space rules, at least a beginner’s grasp of them…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The deeper he contemplated space rules, the deeper his understanding became.

The essence of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was to use the Dao of Taiji as the core, to contain all Dao, and thereby control all Dao.

Incorporating his own understanding and insights of ‘Dao’ into it, would then perfect the Dao of Taiji and use it to control all Dao.

Lin Yuan felt that for him, the most complete path for the Seventh Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was to integrate space rules.

Of course.

This was only in regard to Lin Yuan himself.

Other Evolvers didn’t need to integrate space rules specifically; any other rules could work as well.

It depends on what each individual excels at. Entering the realm of space rules is incredibly difficult, and only a Seventh Rank Evolver would be confident in mastering it.

However, the threshold for entering other rules is much lower.

For example, in the Seven Stars Cave Trial World, that Red Pattern Examiner’s brute strength was a beginner’s grasp of the Rule of Power.

To grasp the Rule of Power at the Fourth Rank was indeed genius; it showed that it could be done.

Other Martial Arts Evolvers just need to grasp a certain rule that suits them at the zenith of the Sixth Rank in order to have a chance to step into the Seventh Rank.

…

“The Physical Body Divine Ability is being nurtured…” Lin Yuan keenly felt the changes in his body.

He noticed that, deep within his bloodline, a peculiar force was awakening and converging.

This was very similar to the first time he had developed a Physical Body Divine Ability in the Immortal Tao World.

“It should take another day or two…”

Lin Yuan estimated in his mind.

The birth of a Physical Body Divine Ability doesn’t happen instantly; it needs time to be nurtured.

Based on the current pace of nurturing, Lin Yuan felt that in one or two days, the Physical Body Divine Ability would probably be born.

“Hm?”

“Fang Qing is looking for me?”

Lin Yuan scanned the visitor records and discovered that Fang Qing wanted to see him.

Virtual World.

Personal Space.

Lin Yuan and Fang Qing sat facing each other.

“No need to be formal, just act as before,” Lin Yuan casually said, noting Fang Qing’s nervousness.

He had a close friendship with Fang Qing, who had helped him since the Seven Star Cave trials by providing information.

Later, when Lin Yuan was subjected to the public’s scorn by the hundreds of billions of citizens on Canglan Star because of the Heiyu Family’s oppression,

It was Fang Qing who had stood up for him, going so far as to offer numerous favors to rebuild trade relations for Canglan Star.

Though, in truth,

The Heiyu Family could only do so much back then, and the external public opinion had not affected Lin Yuan at all.

But Fang Qing truly wanted to help him.

“Brother Lin, you say it so lightly, just as before…” Fang Qing relaxed a bit and managed a smile, saying, “But your status now, you’re a Peak Master of the Red Kun Lineage…”

Although Fang Qing said this, his heart settled down.

At this moment, he was extremely grateful that he had fully supported Lin Yuan through his difficulties in the past.

Otherwise, with Lin Yuan’s current status, Fang Qing might not even be able to see him.

As far as Fang Qing knew, since Lin Yuan’s arrival at the Chikun Main Star, he had hardly met with any outsiders.

“How have you been recently?”

Lin Yuan asked casually.

“Not bad,”

Fang Qing said softly, “Many people, aware of my relationship with Brother Lin, want to get close to me, hoping to use me to reach out to Brother Lin…”

When Canglan Star faced suppression from the Heiyu Family, Fang Qing had stood up for his friend.

Subsequently, this friend transformed into the Peak Master of the Chikun Star Domain.

The person whose status changed the most in between, apart from Lin Yuan and his family, was—
